guide.summary: Local LLM council aligned GPU driver evidence with a concrete reinstall-and-retest sequence.
guide.chiefVerdict: Clean reinstall the display driver, reboot, then capture a fresh FPS baseline under the same game settings.

councilDiscussion.content: Driver version drift explains the FPS regression more than thermal throttling.
councilDiscussion.headline: Driver mismatch

councilDiscussion.content: Proceed with a clean driver reinstall before changing in-game settings.
councilDiscussion.headline: Driver first

steps.title: Open Device Manager
steps.instructions: Open Device Manager, uninstall the display adapter with driver removal enabled, then reboot before installing the latest vendor driver.

steps.title: Capture FPS baseline
steps.instructions: Launch the same title and settings after reboot, then capture a second FPS sample so the council can compare before and after latency.
